design_system_name: NivXRay XDR Visual Language: Deterministic Obsidian & Kinetic Amber
aesthetic_philosophy: Evidence-First + Causal + Deterministic + Epistemically Explicit. Avoid generic violet SaaS slop, flat black slabs, and misleading glowing arrows. High-density, tactical SOC console aesthetics optimized for long analytical shifts with strict cognitive clarity.

typography.body_font_family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

severity_indicator.description: Encodes rank using shape glyph + label + color for multi-sensory colorblind accessibility.

epistemic_badges.description: LOCKED product-differentiator vocabulary. Expresses exact truth state without fallback sample data.

relationship_grammar.description: Strict edge rendering rules for Evidence Graph and Attack Story. No glowing directional arrows unless backed by evidence.

states.default: Dark glass fill (#121721), 1px subtle border, type icon, label, disposition dot.
states.aggregate: Carries count badge (e.g., '9 Processes'), distinct double-ring outline.
states.selected: 2px bright border (#38BDF8), glow pulse halo, auto-loads Evidence Inspector.
states.hover: Elevated layer z-index, highlighted connecting edges, tooltip preview.
states.gap: Dashed border (#64748B), 'GAP' status pill, diagnostic recommendation.

states.default: Background Layer 1, 1px border, metric value, subtext, indicator dot.
states.active: Border highlight (#F59E0B), subtle accent left rail (3px), active queue filter indicator.
states.hover: Translate Y -1px, shadow elevation, text-primary glow.

evidence_inspector_row.structure: 2-column layout. Left: Uppercase Monospace Label (35% width, color tertiary). Right: Selectable Monospace Value (65% width, text primary).
evidence_inspector_row.empty_state: Select any technique, process, event, command, finding, or entity to inspect authoritative evidence.

not_implemented_block.style: Subtle hatched background pattern, muted text, disabled CTA with explanatory tooltip.

hierarchy_question_order: 1. What is the scope and severity of active threats? (KPI Lens Strip: Critical, High, Unassigned, My Queue, SLA Risk)
2. Which incidents need immediate action? (Filtered Dense Incidents Table with State Counts)
3. What are the key details without losing context? (Right-side Slide-over Incident Preview Drawer)

layout_structure.top: Header + KPI Lens Strip (5 active count tiles) + Quick Filters Bar (Assignee, Severity, Verdict, Source)
layout_structure.main: Full-width Incident Queue Table with custom density toggle, state tabs (All 198 / New 191 / In Progress 7 / On Hold / Resolved / Closed)
layout_structure.drawer: Slide-over panel (450px) showing selected incident summary, attack timeline, affected assets, and instant action buttons.

hierarchy_question_order: 1. What happened & what is affected? (Header + Lifecycle Rail + Stat Strip: Evidence, Alerts, Hosts, Users, Files, MITRE)
2. Why is it suspicious? (Verdict Arithmetic Matrix + Key Contributor Findings)
3. Show evidence & allow response! (Tabbed Workbench with Inspector and Action Toolbar)

tab_reorganization_solution.problem: 12 flat tabs carry no counts and overwhelm the analyst.

hierarchy_question_order: 2. Relationship visualization (Center Canvas with explicit Relationship Grammar)
3. Authoritative evidence inspection (Right Evidence Inspector - zero fabricated data)
3_attack_story_and_evidence_graph.layout_columns: 320px Left Alert Timeline Rail | Flexible Center Graph/Story Canvas | 360px Right Evidence Inspector
3_attack_story_and_evidence_graph.diagnostics_bar: Displays Attack Chain Completeness, Evidence Coverage, MITRE Coverage, Telemetry Coverage, Telemetry Gaps.

hierarchy_question_order: 1. What is the current threat & posture delta across tenants? (Top KPI Metric Cards)
2. Which tenant requires immediate SOC intervention? (Customer Operations Grid & SLA Alert Matrix)
3. How are automated investigations performing? (Detection & Auto-Investigation Overview)
4_mss_dashboard.layout_grid: Top 10 KPI Cards -> 2/3 Customer Tenant Operations Matrix + 1/3 Recent Activity & Threat Feed -> Full-width Detection Overview

verdict_arithmetic_visibility.concept: Expose exact contributor-by-contributor score derivation when authoritative backend contributor data exists.
verdict_arithmetic_visibility.ui_pattern: Interactive breakdown box showing Base Score + Contributor Modifiers (e.g. +35 Anomaly Detection, +25 Lateral Movement, +20 Malicious Hash) = Final Severity Score.

accessibility_and_contrast.standards_target: WCAG 2.1 AA / APCA >= 60 Lc for body text, >= 45 Lc for large text/badges.
accessibility_and_contrast.colorblind_support: Every severity, disposition, and epistemic badge uses shape glyphs (▲, ◆, ○, ⊘, ℹ) and text labels alongside color.

forbidden_ui_patterns: Flat near-black slab with no border or depth separation
ASCII tree glyphs (└──) instead of crisp SVG structural trees or real HTML indentation
Low-contrast dark grey labels on black background
All-uppercase monospace text for every label making visual hierarchy impossible
Uniform row rhythm without metric grouping or progressive disclosure
Full-bleed inputs with no distinct field background or border affordance
Glowing directional arrows implying causality where only correlation exists
Fabricated mock backend data or sample values when real evidence is missing

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color tokens and typography scale defined above.
Ensure all interactive components include data-testid attributes.
Support both dark (default) and light themes cleanly via the .xdr-console data-nx-theme attribute.
Never replace missing evidence with fake mock data; render the official epistemic badge (◆ EVIDENCE PRESENT, ◇ NO EVIDENCE, ? UNKNOWN, ○ NOT RUN, ⊘ CAPABILITY UNAVAILABLE).
Implement the locked relationship grammar on all Evidence Graphs and Attack Stories.
